svg.text: Request path flows down the left · delivery pipeline flows down the right
Browser reaches nginx over TLS; port 80 redirects to 443
nginx serves index.html and hashed assets from the volume
/api is proxied to the application over plain HTTP
The app connects as that environment’s own database role
frontend-runner publishes the built bundle into the volume
catalog-runner copies the JAR and a 600-mode .env, then restarts
• Runners poll GitHub outbound over HTTPS — nothing connects inward.
• Pull requests build on GitHub-hosted runners only; fork code never reaches this machine.
• srv-qa and srv-prod are not built yet; prod is planned on its own isolated network.
• Host ports 443/80 → nginx · 8081 → srv-dev · 2222 → ssh · 5433 → postgres
